[PREFERENCE] User is looking for modern options for a dresser with smooth-gliding drawers.  
[FACT] User's current dresser has drawers that are always getting stuck.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations for a dresser with smooth-gliding drawers include:

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips include reading reviews, checking the warranty, and testing the dresser in-store.  
[PREFERENCE] User is concerned about the size of the dresser due to a small bedroom.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for measuring the room and finding a dresser that fits well include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Take precise measurements of the room and the space for the dresser.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Measure doorways and hallways to ensure the dresser can fit through.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Consider the scale of the dresser in relation to the room size.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Use online room planners or apps to visualize the space.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Dresser size guidelines include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Standard dresser width is between 36-48 inches; consider a narrower dresser for small rooms.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Typical dresser depth is around 18-20 inches.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Common dresser height is 30-40 inches.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Compact options include a 24-inch wide dresser for extremely limited space.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips include leaving breathing room around the dresser and considering a vertical dresser for high ceilings.
